justification: Both are stone reliefs organized in horizontal registers with schematic geometric infill and a rounded/disc motif, but A depicts a single stylized anthropomorphic figure (face, arms, belt, breast-disc) while B depicts a frieze of animals (birds, a quadruped, a snake-like form) beneath basket-like arches. The biggest difference is subject matter itself—human figure versus animal narrative scene—so beyond generic use of pattern and circular shapes there is little specific correspondence.
